turns.message: Claims automation cut discharge turnaround by 6 to 7 hours, and 57% of executives are NHCX-ready. Ambient scribing drafts prescriptions in under a minute with 90% needing no edits. These deliver immediate operational wins despite budget cuts.

adjustments.reason: Discharge turnaround cuts of 6 to 7 hours and 57% NHCX readiness demonstrate strong immediate return.

turns.message: EMR adoption is only about 35% for ambient scribing, requiring doctors to stay in the loop. Radiology models rely on Western data, PACS is not AI-ready, and per-patient ROI is unproven. Additionally, post-discharge lacks clear reimbursement models and EMR is too thin.

adjustments.reason: EMR adoption is only about 35% and doctors must remain in the loop.

turns.message: With our 50% budget cut, radiology's high GPU costs and unproven per-patient ROI are unacceptable. Scheduling chatbots show limited incremental value. We must fund finance automation where 83% have ERP integrated, finance AI is live, audit-friendly, and carries no clinical exposure.

adjustments.reason: High GPU costs and unproven per-patient ROI make it unsustainable under budget constraints.

verdict.summary: With a 50% budget cut, capital must concentrate on claims and ERP finance automation where proven discharge efficiencies and existing integration provide immediate stability. Capital-intensive radiology and data-constrained monitoring projects are paused due to high GPU costs and immature EMR infrastructure.
